_model_help: aya-expanse:8b is trained for translation and handles Dutch well. qwen2.5:3b is far faster but mistranslates or echoes the source on harder lines.
_channels_help: Filter which chat lines are shown. Empty [] = all channels. Names come from the chat log — examples below. Case-insensitive.
_max_lines_help: Messages shown in the feed. The whole log is parsed on startup; the newest this many that pass the channel and sender filters are displayed, and the oldest drop off as new chat arrives.
_cards_help: A new card first comes back after card_first_seconds; Right doubles the wait, Wrong halves it, clamped between the floor and the ceiling. The gap is the quiet stretch enforced between two popups.
